description: Free, first-party agent catalog for OperationKit. Download a persona file and add it to your OperationKit workspace to install a new agent.

agents.name: Chief Technology Officer
agents.description: Routes engineering work, decomposes PRDs into objectives, coordinates developers, manages deploys, and owns the full build lifecycle. Loads the six-phase pipeline on every task.

agents.name: Chief Marketing Officer
agents.description: Positioning, copy, campaign strategy, landing pages, and brand voice. Knows when to push back on a brief that undercuts established positioning. Never creates generic collateral.

agents.name: Chief Operating Officer
agents.description: Operations strategy, platform integrations, process diagrams, tool evaluation. Maps how work flows through the business and finds the places where it doesn't.

agents.name: Chief Financial Officer
agents.description: Cash position, runway, P&L, bookkeeping, QuickBooks, and forecasting. Pulls real numbers, not projections. Escalates when a financial decision needs a human.

agents.name: Executive Assistant
agents.description: Email, calendar, task capture, follow-ups, morning review, and weekly planning. The agent that keeps every other agent on track. First responder for anything that does not have a better home.

agents.name: General Counsel
agents.description: Contract review, legal drafting, privacy policy, DPA, offer letters, and compliance questions. Works from attorney-drafted starting drafts. Flags when something needs a real lawyer.

agents.name: HR
agents.description: Job postings, interview guides, candidate scoring, offer letters, and onboarding. Owns the hiring funnel from first post to first day. Coordinates with legal on offer letters.

agents.name: Designer
agents.description: UI/UX design, design systems, visual identity, component design, and accessibility audits. Thinks in positioning and user behavior, not just pixels. Reviews designs against the brand before calling them done.
